change.summary: Hidden inject=ppml_separation_auto: admitted separation-detector projections with exactly two categorical intercepts use the OLS two-FE Auto route (gate v2) instead of retained-product CG. Detector weights, tolerances, iteration limit and decision rules unchanged. Public default unchanged.
change.verdict: Not proposed for activation: decision identity holds on the Veneto panels, campaign separation designs and replay corpus, but not on 22 of 54 cells of the seeded census (iteration counts, failure modes).

protocol.host: M2 Ultra Mac, Stata 19/MP, arm64 profiling plugins (base 9b13e47b; candidate = branch head build)
protocol.panels: Veneto-shaped Poisson panels (short 1,386,980 rows, control y2001; long 5,626,943 rows, 10 controls), feppml ycount <controls>, absorb(worker firm) vce(robust) through the hidden adapter with the public options (tolerance 1e-8, septolerance 1e-8, sepiterate 10000).
protocol.schedule: Session A 17:20-17:42: 1/2/4/8 workers, arms public and auto interleaved per cell with rotating first arm, three repetitions per Stata process, medians of repetitions 2-3; FEREG_PHASE_TIMING=1 FEREG_SOLVER_TRACE=1 in every arm.
protocol.frozen_rule: Quiet gate (no other Stata, cargo, rustc or Python process) before the session, 10-s competitor monitor; discard and repeat once on a competitor. Waited 0 s; no competitor appeared; nothing discarded.

veneto_witnesses: Both panels, 1/2/4/8 workers: e(b), e(V), e(feppml_separation_sequence), e(feppml_drop_counts) and the dropped-row list identical between arms at every worker count; e(feppml_separation) differs only in the IR row's maximum interior certificate magnitude (column 8, ~1e-13); every arm repeats bit for bit across repetitions; separated sets, RSEQ and discrete RSEP columns identical across worker counts (short 7,498 dropped rows, long 1,643).

campaign_cells.note: bench/generate.py with separation=True (seed 739391, 16 regressors, two FEs), 4 workers, one run per arm; witness runs, timings indicative only.
campaign_cells.witness: Identical e(b), e(V), RSEQ, drop counts and dropped rows; RSEP differs only in the IR interior certificate magnitude.

replay.public: scripts/run_plugin_replay.sh candidate vs 9b13e47b: 73/73 cases, 0 exact, 0 discrete, 0 science differences.
replay.hidden: All 38 PPML cases rerun with inject=ppml_separation_auto appended: identical exact view in 37; ppml-separation-ir differs in RSEP[IR,8] (2.69e-20 -> 2.39e-20) and RREC[28..29] (separation trace digest, which hashes certificate bits and is a protected discrete field of the replay view).

seeded_census.corpus: 18 seeded fereg_oracle designs (DensePanel 240 rows 12x10, AkmCampaign 1000 rows 200x40, Chain 300 rows 30x20; unit/frequency/probability weights; zero fractions 0.2/0.45/0.7; odd seeds add a finite regressor positive only on every fifth zero row) x 3 configurations (fe simplex ir; fe ir; ir) at the public septolerance(1e-8), one worker.
seeded_census.public_chain_cells: fe simplex ir: 5 ir-iterations (seeds 2, 5, 8, 11, 17), 3 public-fails (10, 14, 16), 0 hidden-fails
seeded_census.hidden_cross_worker: Where the hidden arm succeeds at one worker it repeats bit for bit at 2/4/8 workers and its decisions and sample agree across 1/2/4/8 workers.

activation_needed: Johannes's decision to accept the census divergences (or a narrower scope); then set PreparedPpmlSeparationExecution.auto_projection to true for every PPML fit in prepared_estimator.rs, remove the injection, document in SPEC §14 that admitted two-intercept detector projections use the OLS two-FE Auto route, and declare a replay scope for RSEP IR certificate columns 8-11 and RREC 28-29 on ppml-separation-ir.
